text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year!
Welcome to the New Year's Party!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The new year. Invited by Satono Diamond, I attended the Satono Group's New Year's party.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Apparently, it's a gathering for relatives and affiliates of the Satono Group to exchange New Year's greetings.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me so soon after our meeting,
but my father and mother would like to greet you, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
Thank you for taking such good care of Dia.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Last year during her Classic Year,
my daughter performed far beyond our expectations.
This is all thanks to your guidance, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Dia's intuition was right—
I'll be counting on you in the Senior class as well.
choice_data_list: Yes. I will definitely guide her to become a "great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Yes. I have high expectations.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I have greetings to make around the venue,
so please excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please,
make yourself comfortable and enjoy the festivities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's parents are said to hold central positions within the family. It seems their daughter is quite busy as well.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Coach
text_block_list.text:
Dia-san, Happy New Year!
You've been doing amazing in the Twinkle Series, haven't you!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Doctor
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, every time I watch your races, I'm filled with deep emotion seeing how remarkably you've grown, Dia-san, since you were so little.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year.
Coach, Sensei, it's been a long time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I am doing wonderfully.
The foundation of my running was built by the coaches.
I am deeply grateful from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Coach
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been bragging to my current students that I used to coach the one and only Dia-san!
They've been in absolute awe, saying how amazing it is!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My, ufufu. I'm honored♪
Though Coach, even before you began instructing me, you already had quite a reputation for being extraordinarily skilled, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're a renowned professor in nutritional science yourself, Sensei.
If anything, others were envious of me having such an outstanding mentor.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Doctor
text_block_list.text:
My, how skilled.
You already look like a fine representative of the Satono Group.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, not nearly enough.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am currently thinking about
how I ought to be as a "great Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Dia's Former Coach
text_block_list.text: Being such a renowned Umamusume... I wonder if she's thinking of competing overseas someday?

text_block_list.name: Sports Brand Rep
text_block_list.text:
If you are considering overseas races,
I can prepare training equipment and shoes specifically suited for overseas use.

text_block_list.name: Sports Brand Rep
text_block_list.text:
We can also develop a custom one for Lady Diamond.
Please feel free to place an order at any time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The training machine your company built for us
is still being used and loved at my family's home.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If you ever require new equipment,
would you allow me to develop it again?

text_block_list.name: Sports Brand Rep
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
Lady Diamond is the shining star of the Satono Group.
We shall spare no effort to support her to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I'll be sure to reach out to you soon♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An exceptional coach, top-tier doctors,
and support from sports equipment manufacturers...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond has been blessed with so much support
since she was little. It truly shows
how immense everyone's expectations are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Conversely, it also carried a heavy burden of responsibility.
She had to repay the favors she received through her achievements on the track.
Regardless of her own will, that responsibility would follow her everywhere."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—During this Senior Class year,
I have to deliver results together with her: victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the New Year's party,
I go for Hatsumode with Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
you certainly took your time praying.
choice_data_list: Just making a small declaration of my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're talking about my race, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I would've liked to declare my resolution alongside you,
but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Instead, I got to see your serious face,
Trainer-san, so that makes it all worth it♪ Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, regarding what's next...
How do you plan to spend your time, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, I'd love to hear
how you spent New Year's, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Both my family and Kita-chan's household
are quite accustomed to large banquets, you see.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I would like you to teach me ways to spend time
other than parties and banquets!
Please let me accompany you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We were only supposed to talk,
but before I knew it, we ended up hanging out together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Speaking of my usual New Year's—
choice_data_list: Do the first calligraphy of the new year

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Are you going to sleep already?
Is that some kind of special training to see a good first dream of the year, or—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that while it can involve sleeping,
it mostly means lounging around and not leaving the house.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My, lounging around right at the start of the new year...
It feels a little delightfully sinful, doesn't it?♪
Let's be totally lazy this New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to munch on snacks in the trainer's office
while watching New Year TV specials.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...Even though this is supposed to be a trip by local bus, they're doing almost all of it on foot..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wah! This unaju looks so delicious...!
choice_data_list: Now that makes me want to eat some.
Makes you want to eat some, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they are open today as well,
so shall we order delivery?
choice_data_list: That's way too far for delivery?!
That's way too far for delivery, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. Both you and I are working so hard,
Trainer. I'm sure Father will grant
a small indulgence like this♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—we ate our fill
of exquisite unaju delivered via the Shinkansen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Lucky bags! Those are so exciting, aren't they!
I want to buy one too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In search of lucky bags,
I came to the shopping mall with Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Which shop should we go to...?
Oh, look, they have lucky bags for food and tea as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If it's food, even if it's not to our taste,
it'll be easy to share.
Let's head over there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What a huge line...
It looks like it'll take a while,
so how about an observation quiz while we wait?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We're going to guess which shop
the passersby will enter!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then, starting with that man in the down coat over there.
I bet he's going into the cafe!
choice_data_list: I think she's probably headed to the bookstore upstairs.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah, they went into a cafe!
Ehehe, I was right♪
They did look quite tired, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Doing the quiz made the time fly by, didn't it?
Come, let's head home and open our lucky bags!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I enjoyed the time waiting in line,
and managed to buy a lucky bag!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kakizome, is it?... In that case,
I'd love to try doing giant calligraphy!
choice_data_list: Do you mean a calligraphy performance?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll have someone from my household
buy a large brush and calligraphy paper!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, since it was New Year's and nobody was using it,
we were able to borrow the gymnasium to do giant New Year's calligraphy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmm... If I don't maintain a clear mental image, I feel like I'll lose my balance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond carefully planned her concept in front of the calligraphy paper,
then swiftly dashed across it with a brush almost as tall as herself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Teryaaaaaaaah!
Hah! Seiya! Take that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Phew!
How does that look, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with graceful, beautiful brushstrokes,
she splendidly wrote, "Long-Cherished Desire Fulfilled"!
